units.source_en: For in his heart, he regarded Watanabe Kannai as an exceptionally distinguished retainer of Ishikawa's, one with whom he was thoroughly pleased.
units.source_zh: 其实，在他心里，渡边金内是石川手下一位令他非常满意的、极为出众的家臣。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管作左口无遮拦，金内还是施了一礼才出发。这时候，作左卫门才向着金内远去的背影深深地鞠了一躬。其实，在他心里，渡边金内是石川手下一位令他非常满意的、极为出众的家臣。

paragraphs.source_en: Kannai urged his horse onward, and before long he vanished into the vast morning mist.

units.source_en: Kannai urged his horse onward, and before long he vanished into the vast morning mist.
units.source_zh: 金内快马加鞭，不久，便消失在茫茫的晨雾之中。
